definitions.short: Tou or Toi , a Syrian king
definitions.full: H8583. Tou or Toi תֹּ֫עִי proper name, masculine king of Hamath , 2Sam 8:9-10 , (twice in verse) = תֹּ֫עוּ (which We Dr and others prefer) 1Chr 18:9-10 ,. I, II. תְּעָלָה see עלה p. 752. תַּעֲלוּלִים see I. עלל . תַּעֲלֻמָה see [I. עלם ]. תַּעֲנוּג see [ ענג ]. p .761, 772 תַּעֲנִית see [III. ענה ] p.777.
